stem: A pharmacist learns of a quality-related event at 3 p.m. Monday. When must the initial event documentation be completed?

choices.text: Use the out-of-state prescription rule when its schedule, age, and verification conditions have not been checked.
Process another refill because an authorization written by the prescriber overrides schedule limits.
Within 24 hours after the pharmacist discovered or was told of the event.
Treat the request as an insufficient-stock partial fill and use the 72-hour remainder rule.
Handle the drug or transaction as ordinary Massachusetts Schedule VI activity.

explanation.core_reasoning: The pharmacist who discovers or receives notice of a quality-related event must initially document it within 24 hours after discovery or notification. The pharmacy must use the exact trigger and deadline rather than borrowing a nearby controlled-substance rule.

choice_analysis.A: That choice belongs, if at all, to Out-of-state Schedule III through VI prescriptions; its trigger does not match this scenario.
choice_analysis.B: That choice belongs, if at all, to Federal Schedule III and IV refill limits; its trigger does not match this scenario.
choice_analysis.C: This applies Quality-related event documentation deadline: The pharmacist who discovers or receives notice of a quality-related event must initially document it within 24 hours after discovery or notification.
choice_analysis.D: That choice belongs, if at all, to Schedule II partial fill caused by pharmacy inability; its trigger does not match this scenario.
choice_analysis.E: That choice belongs, if at all, to Massachusetts Schedule VI prescription-drug status; its trigger does not match this scenario.

related_facts: The pharmacist who discovers or receives notice of a quality-related event must initially document it within 24 hours after discovery or notification.
explanation.mpje_trap: Applying insufficient stock to facts controlled by qre documentation.

reasoning_steps: Identify the trigger for Quality-related event documentation deadline
